svg.title: OffBall high-level architecture
svg.desc: Detailed architecture across eight domains: Match Simulation, Data Ingestion, the match engine with Performance Metrics and Tactical Intelligence, Insight Generation, Broadcast, Audience, shared Cosmos DB, and the Platform band with OneLake, Fabric, monitoring, security and GitHub.
svg.text: Dedupe · align clocks · corrections · gap fill
Stats API · as_of cut-off · reads Cosmos
Same cue feed via Web PubSub
events · metrics · windows · triggers · insights · checkpoints · cues

Fast path: stats hub → PubSub bridge → screens (under 1 s). AI path: triggers hub → agents → checked captions → cue manager (a few seconds). Every cue goes on air automatically; the producer can pull any.
